label: TikTok Transcript Scraper
title: TikTok Transcript Scraper: Captions, Stats & MP4s
metaDescription: Extract spoken transcripts from TikTok videos as text, SRT or WebVTT with timestamps, plus 58 fields per video. Optional watermark-free MP4 download.
intro: Paste TikTok video links and get the spoken transcript as text, SRT or WebVTT with timestamps, plus 58 fields per video: upload date, views, likes, saves, hashtags, sound and the creator's follower count. Pick a caption language, or download the MP4 without the watermark.
useCases: Turn viral TikToks into text for hook and script research
Track a creator's views and engagement per video
Subtitle or translate short videos you have the rights to

faq.q: Does every TikTok video have a transcript?
faq.a: No. Transcripts come from the captions TikTok has for a video. A video without speech, like the sample above, has none, and the row says transcript_available: false.

faq.q: Can I download TikTok videos without the watermark?
faq.a: Yes. Switch video download on and the actor saves the MP4 without the watermark.

officialApi: TikTok's Research API is limited to approved academic researchers, and its Display API only covers accounts that log in to your own app. This actor works from public video links, with no TikTok account.
